sentences.en: Last night, my friend and I watched a soccer match together.
Both teams played well, and the score stayed close the whole time.
Not long after the match started, one team scored a goal, and everyone got very excited.
In the last five minutes, the score was still tied, and everyone was very tense.
Right when the match was about to end, a player suddenly scored a goal.
The whole stadium was extremely excited, shouting loudly.
That match was really interesting — I still remember it to this day.

quiz.q: What was the score like for most of the match?
a: Tied at zero the whole game

quiz.q: When did the second goal happen?
a: In the last five minutes, just before the match ended

quiz.q: How did the crowd react to the last goal?
a: They were extremely excited and shouted loudly

grammar.e: 还是 before an adjective or verb shows that a situation hasn't changed — it's still the same as before.
grammar.x: 到了最后五分钟，比分还是一样。 — In the last five minutes, the score was still tied.

grammar.e: 就在 + clause + 的时候 marks the exact moment something happened, often right before another event.
grammar.x: 就在比赛快结束的时候，一个队员突然踢进一个球。 — Right when the match was about to end, a player suddenly scored a goal.

grammar.e: 到现在还 + verb shows that something continues to be true up to the present moment.
grammar.x: 那场比赛真有意思，我到现在还记得。 — That match was really interesting — I still remember it to this day.
